subject.title: fix(feishu): prevent duplicate content in streaming cards

question: Must this rewritten branch be exercised against a live Feishu tenant before merge, or is the related reproduction plus exact-head SDK, source, and Testbox evidence sufficient?
rationale: The implementation matches the direct SDK contract and has strong regression coverage, but the current branch explicitly lacks real-tenant proof and carries a protected maintainer label.

options.title: Require tenant proof
options.body: Hold merge until redacted live output, logs, or a recording covers divergent snapshots, retry after business rejection, and closeout consistency.

options.title: Grant proof override
options.body: Accept the related live-validation context plus exact-head contract and Testbox evidence without tenant access to this branch.

recommendation.title: Require tenant proof
recommendation.body: Hold merge until redacted live output, logs, or a recording covers divergent snapshots, retry after business rejection, and closeout consistency.
